instruction_ref: CEO 2026-11-15: 記事制作進んでなくね？ / production status verification and incident remediation
instruction: Prevent signed but no-longer-live historical article snapshots from repeatedly blocking the global scheduled Sellemy growth runtime. Admit legacy published-article repair only when the current article HTML, payload and evidence exist and the category is one of the actual production genres. Unmarked unfinished or unrelated job states are not pending repair. Keep source handoff, history, published content, failure counters, selected topics, independent QA, CEO and publish gates unchanged; no fabricated article baselines, no broadened permissions.
preserved_rules: Missing or untracked baseline is never treated as published or recreated
Original 283 signed source snapshots stay immutable
All existing published article pages and URLs remain intact
One existing eligible published baseline admitted per recovery cycle
No old or active job state, QA receipt, counters or content mutated merely by eligibility checks
No production promotion without explicit CEO Gate
